title: Senators acquire William Eklund from Sharks for No. 9 draft pick
content:
The Ottawa Senators acquired forward William Eklund and two other players from the San Jose Sharks for the No. 9 pick in this week’s NHL Draft, the Sharks announced on Tuesday.

Eklund, a 23-year-old forward, spent parts of the last five seasons with the Sharks, scoring 15 goals and 53 points in 78 games last season and 50 goals and 163 points in 252 career games.

This is the second trade in as many days for the Senators, who traded captain Brady Tkachuk to the Florida Panthers on Sunday in exchange for three first-round picks and a second-round draft pick.

This is a developing story. More to come.
